purpose: Forward-only outcome-blind reconstruction of the complete LAUNCHED_120S cross-mint choice universe at each eligible 2CQ decision.

population.development: first 350 fully eligible choice decisions after cohort start
population.validation: next 150 fully eligible choice decisions, sealed until one primary policy is frozen
population.dedupe: independent 2CQ entry episode under existing Tier-A acquisition semantics

choiceUniverse.boundary: state immediately after the final successful external Pump transaction at or before the causal 2CQ decision boundary
required: canonical finalized successful Pump transaction reconciliation
AllenHark local arrival timestamp for CREATE and every state transition used
continuous compact observer interval covering the complete 120-second launch universe
canonical slot, transaction index, and instruction ordering
complete reserve/state reconstruction through the decision boundary
known teacher exposure for every candidate mint

failClosedReasons: selected mint absent from symmetrically reconstructed universe

materialization.mode: checkpoint reconstruction from existing append-only raw sources
materialization.reason: The existing collectors already preserve every required raw source. Deferring materialization avoids another cumulative high-load writer and does not alter prospective semantics.
